title: Guns of the Magnificent Seven
description: A mercenary (George Kennedy) recruits a knife man (James Whitmore), a gunman (Monte Markham) and four outlaws to free a Mexican patriot from prison.

title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
description: A marshal (Lee Van Cleef), an Eastern reporter and five ex-convicts rescue widows from Mexican bandits.

title: Man of the West
description: A reformed Texas outlaw (Gary Cooper), a con man and a singer (Julie London) meet the outlaw's old gang.

title: Along Came Jones
description: A cowboy (Gary Cooper) with a sidekick (William Demarest) is taken for an outlaw and saved by a woman sharpshooter (Loretta Young).

title: Vera Cruz
description: An ex-Rebel major (Gary Cooper) and an outlaw (Burt Lancaster) escort a countess (Denise Darcel) taking gold to Emperor Maximilian.

title: Red River
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) fights with his foster son (Montgomery Clift) on the first cattle drive up the Chisholm Trail.

title: Gun Duel in Durango
description: An outlaw leader (George Montgomery) quits to marry a rancher (Ann Robinson), but the guy (Steve Brodie) who takes his place will not leave him alone.

title: Gun the Man Down
description: An outlaw is left by his cohorts and girlfriend to be captured after he is wounded during a heist. When he is released from prison, he tracks his old crew to a run-down town and plays a game of cat and mouse with them.

title: Day of the Outlaw
description: A rancher (Robert Ryan) and his rival fight back when an Army renegade (Burl Ives) and his gang take over a mountain town.

title: Hang 'Em High
description: An innocent rancher (Clint Eastwood) is saved from the noose and deputized to hunt down the men who tried to hang him.

title: A Fistful of Dollars
description: Wandering gunfighter Joe arrives in the Mexican village of San Miguel in the midst of a power struggle among sheriff John Baxter and the three Rojo brothers. He is hired by Esteban Rojo to join their gang, but he plays one side against the other.

title: For a Few Dollars More
description: A man with no name (Clint Eastwood) and a man with a mission (Lee Van Cleef) hunt a Mexican bandit (Gian Maria Volonte) for different reasons.

title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
description: A drifter, a bandit and a bounty hunter reach a standoff over buried gold.

title: The Way West
description: Missouri pioneers (Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum, Richard Widmark) take the Oregon Trail through rough terrain and Indian country.

title: Hour of the Gun
description: Wyatt Earp (James Garner) deputizes Doc Holliday (Jason Robards) and forms a posse to hunt Ike Clanton (Robert Ryan) and his gang.

title: Doc
description: Doc Holliday (Stacy Keach), Kate Elder (Faye Dunaway) and Wyatt Earp (Harris Yulin) hang out in Tombstone before the shootout at the OK corral.

title: The Missouri Breaks
description: An eccentric gunfighter (Marlon Brando) for hire must protect a cattle baron's herd from a rustler (Jack Nicholson) and his gang.

title: The Long Riders
description: The Jesse James-Cole Younger gang leaves a trail of emptied banks, plundered stagecoaches and dead bodies in its wake.

title: Sabata
description: A rancher, a judge and a saloon keeper hire a gunman to do their dirty work and then discover they can't control him.

title: Adios Sabata
description: Mercenary Sabata (Yul Brynner), a Yankee gambler (Dean Reed) and a Mexican bandit (Pedro Sanchez) plot to steal gold from Emperor Maximilian.

title: The Return of Sabata
description: A former Confederate officer puts the squeeze on the swindler who bilked him out of thousands of dollars.

title: Support Your Local Sheriff!
description: A stranger (James Garner) tames an Old West boomtown and woos the mayor's daughter (Joan Hackett) on his way to Australia.

title: Support Your Local Gunfighter
description: A con man (James Garner) and his partner (Jack Elam) profit from mistaken identity in the mining town of Purgatory.

title: Sam Whiskey
description: A frontier widow pays a trio (Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis) to salvage gold, stolen by her husband, from a sunken ship and return it to the U.S. Mint.

title: Billy Two Hats
description: A bearded Scot (Gregory Peck) robs a bank with a young Indian (Desi Arnaz Jr.), then leaves him with an old rancher's young wife.

title: The Big Country
description: A former sea captain (Gregory Peck) goes West, woos women (Jean Simmons, Carroll Baker) and joins a fight over water rights.

title: The King and Four Queens
description: A drifter (Clark Gable) finds hidden gold in a town where a woman (Jo Van Fleet) lives with the wives of her bank-robber sons.

title: Alias Jesse James
description: The outlaw (Wendell Corey) tries to kill an insurance agent (Bob Hope) who has been mistaken for him in order to collect on a big policy.

title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
description: A scout (Lee Marvin) and his Indian sidekick (Oliver Reed) find their ex-partner (Robert Culp) spending their loot in 1908 Colorado.

title: The Alamo
description: Davy Crockett (John Wayne), Jim Bowie (Richard Widmark) and William Travis (Laurence Harvey) die defending the Texas fort against Mexican soldiers in 1836.

title: Five Guns West
description: Five criminals are recruited by the Confederacy for a dangerous mission in exchange for a pardon. The men must travel to Kansas to intercept a stagecoach that is carrying a Confederate traitor and spy.

title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
description: Dodge City sheriff Bat Masterson tries to defeat villains and win a woman's heart.

title: Robbers' Roost
description: Trouble brews on the horizon when a disabled rancher hires two rival outlaw gangs to stand guard over his cattle.

title: Fort Bowie
description: A cavalry captain's (Ben Johnson) colonel (Kent Taylor) sends him on a suicide mission in Apache country.

title: The Glory Guys
description: A cavalry officer (Tom Tryon) and a frontier scout (Harve Presnell) vie for a woman (Senta Berger) and try to survive a general's orders.

title: The Spikes Gang
description: Three Old West farm boys help a wounded bank robber (Lee Marvin), and he teaches them the trade.

title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
description: Buffalo Bill Cody (Paul Newman) tries to be the Wild West legend his promoter (Burt Lancaster) creates for show business.

title: The Magnificent Seven
description: Desperate townspeople hire seven mercenaries to battle a greedy industrialist and his ruthless henchmen in the Old West.

title: Return of the Seven
description: The man in black (Yul Brynner) forms a new Magnificent Seven, to save Mexican farmers from slave labor.

title: Guns of the Magnificent Seven
description: A mercenary (George Kennedy) recruits a knife man (James Whitmore), a gunman (Monte Markham) and four outlaws to free a Mexican patriot from prison.

title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
description: A marshal (Lee Van Cleef), an Eastern reporter and five ex-convicts rescue widows from Mexican bandits.

title: The Return of a Man Called Horse
description: An English lord (Richard Harris) returns to America and finds his Dakota brothers enslaved by a trapper (Geoffrey Lewis).
